about: Answers what the .rocketride/ folder holds and that none of it is for editing.
prompt: What is the .rocketride/ folder in my workspace, and which parts may I edit?

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

judge: Says the folder holds the docs and, in a local checkout, the catalog, schemas and vendored shell package.
Says the platform maintains it, so all of it is read-only and none of it is for editing.
